summary: PrintJobs manages the creation, processing, grouping, and delivery of print job reports in an academic, clinical or placement management system. It orchestrates multiple report-oriented workflows, supports various report types (letters, schedules, lists), and enforces business constraints such as maximum batch sizes, role-based permissions, and error handling.
purpose: To provide a unified service for generating, managing, and tracking print jobs and report batches, including placement schedules, confirmation letters, assessments, staff lists, and destination profiles for students, staff, and agencies. It automates email notifications, file generation, status tracking, and grouping of reports for streamlined batch operations.

workflows.name: Report Generation Workflow
steps: Validate input lists (e.g., EnrollmentIDList, DestinationIDList) for null/empty and maximum allowed items.
Create report jobs via stored procedure (DB.ProcedureName) with session and relevant parameters.
On success, add warning message indicating report added to queue.
Handle error messages for invalid input (empty lists, batch size exceeded, no confirmed placements, etc.).

workflows.name: Print Job Grouping and Searching
steps: Search print jobs by various filters (user ID, status, keywords).
Group jobs based on name/date proximity, adjust group attributes and indexes.
Format job names for alternate language modes and display logic.
Return grouped lists for UI operations (toggle, indent, etc.).

workflows.name: Email Notification Workflow
steps: Construct EmailClientClick JavaScript for sending report emails.
Generate subject and attach URLs based on job and recipient information.
Handle special cases for single/multiple PRD_IDs and missing email addresses.

business_rules: Input lists must not be empty; errors are generated otherwise.
For group jobs, PRD_IDs must be present; else fallback to PRDLIST_SINGLE.
Staff roles must be selected for staff list reports; else error.
Date logic: Start date must not be after end date; handle nulls and default ranges.
Reports are only created if valid confirmed placements exist.
validations: ValidStartEndDate: Checks start/end dates, parses input, enforces range and default values.
Role selection validation: At least one staff role must be selected.
Batch size validation: Input arrays not to exceed MAX_INCLUDE_ITEMS.
Null/empty list validation: No report if lists are empty.
calculations: Date range calculation for placement schedules and term-based reports.
Group index calculation for chunked report lists.
Formatted status logic based on readiness/viewed flags.
conditions: If input list is empty or exceeds max size, report job is not created.
For alternate language, job names/status displays change.
For individual PDFs, loop through list and create per-item jobs.
system_behavior: Executes stored procedures for creating various report jobs.
Groups jobs dynamically for UI toggle/display.
Handles display and email notification logic based on job readiness/status.
Tracks report view/sent statuses and formats accordingly.
Deletes or sets job statuses via PrintJobSetStatus/PrintJobDelete.
dependencies: HSPnetSession for session and database access.
Stored procedures: e.g., ReportPlacementRequestAssessmentCreateJob, ReportConfLetterCreateJob, ReportStaffListCreateJob, PrintJobSearchToday, PrintJobSetStatus, PrintJobDelete, etc.
exceptions: No confirmed placements for certain job types.
Invalid dates (start after end, parse errors).
Missing staff roles for staff list jobs.
content_gaps: Business logic details for stored procedures (e.g., actual report creation, job processing) are abstracted and not fully disclosed.
Some references to external constants, UI logic, and resources (e.g., error messages, maximum values) are assumed as implemented elsewhere.
No explicit error handling code for database or infrastructure failures beyond business rule enforcement.
